parameters.content:
## Fleet Sync YCN (Chakra 1 & 2)

This workflow:
1. Fetches the YCN brokers page daily
2. Extracts yacht data (slug, title, links)
3. Upserts to your database (Sheets or Airtable)

### Setup Required:
- Configure Google Sheets OR Airtable credentials
- Set your document/base ID
- Create YACHTS table with columns matching schema
